outcome: amount of packed red blood cells (PRBCs)
cohort: 170 patients with surgically or pathologically confirmed placenta accreta, increta or percreta examined from 2013 to 2017.
finding: Intraoperative aortic balloon occlusion (IABO) was efficacious in reducing intraoperative hemorrhage and blood transfusion during cesarean section for placenta increta, but not for placenta accreta or percreta.
